caption: “Baciandomi il culo”. Un Presidente in grande confusione mentale e del tutto unfit. Ad ogni buon conto terrei pronta una bella web tax sul fatturato delle aziende americane. Poi si negozia.
text: Kissing my ass. They are dying to make a deal. Please, please, sir, make a deal. I'll do anything. I'll do anything, sir. And then I'll see some rebel Republican, you know, some guy that wants to grandstand, say, I think that Congress should take over negotiations. Let me tell you, you don't negotiate like I negotiate.
